<summary>
Phase 2 of the CFD solver has been fully implemented. This adds inviscid flux computation, boundary conditions, finite-volume residual assembly, and CSV output to the existing mesh reader.

**New files created (5 headers, 4 implementations):**

- `cfd_solver/src/gas.h` — Perfect gas thermodynamics: `compute_pressure`, `compute_temperature`, `compute_sound_speed`, `compute_mach`, `cons_to_prim`, `prim_to_cons`, `init_freestream`

- `cfd_solver/src/bc.h` + `bc.cpp` — Three boundary conditions: `apply_farfield_bc` (simplified characteristic-based, marked for Phase 5 improvement), `apply_slip_wall_bc` (reflects normal velocity), `apply_no_slip_adiabatic_bc` (mirrors velocity, preserves T/p)

- `cfd_solver/src/residual.h` + `residual.cpp` — `compute_residual()` assembles FV residual R(U) by looping over all faces. Interior faces use Rusanov flux; boundary faces look up BC type from `CaseConfig::bc_type_for_family(face.bc_family)`, then apply the appropriate BC ghost state. Wall forces are accumulated for slip_wall and no_slip_adiabatic faces, normalized by q∞·ref_area into CL and CD. `compute_residual_norm()` returns per-variable L2 norms.

- `cfd_solver/src/output.h` + `output.cpp` — `OutputWriters` struct opens residuals.csv and forces.csv with headers, writes rows in scientific notation, closes on destruction.

**Modified file:**
- `cfd_solver/src/main.cpp` — Extended to: call `build_neighbor_info()`, initialize U with freestream, open output writers, compute initial residual and forces, write CSV rows, print summary.

</changes>
